reason: A client-side Cordis plugin that adds an interactive, animated cockroach overlay to the DSH web interface using SVG, CSS, and timer-driven movement.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面叠加一只可点击、会随机爬行并产生动画效果的写实 SVG 蟑螂。
summaries.en: Adds a clickable realistic SVG cockroach that crawls randomly with animated movement over the DSH web interface.

capabilities: Adds an animated SVG cockroach to the DSH interface overlay
Updates animation and movement on a timer
Handles clicks on the animated overlay element
